semanticLayer.manifestPolicy: render snapshot only; raw vectors are excluded

embeddingProjection.persistence: axes are state; carried forward across rebuilds, re-derived only on --recalculate-projection or embedding model change

spatialPolicy.attentionSignal: human attention may cause weak nightly spatial drift but is not semantic gravity
spatialPolicy.persistence: nightly rebuilds should preserve spatial memory and allow only local drift
spatialPolicy.regionMode: tag-scoped incremental layout with persisted Region seeds and footprints

analytics.snapshotSemantics: attention metrics in this manifest are frozen at rebuild time; live source of truth remains Supabase
analytics.rebuildUse: nightly attention metrics may weakly drift spatial placement but do not change semantic density directly
analytics.historyPolicy: store observations, not interpretations; rebuild snapshots and layout events are append-only audit facts
